description: Presidential Secretariat - Essential Public Services Act, No. 61 of 1979. All Services, Work or Labour of any Description Necessary or Required to be done by or in Connection with the Sri Lanka Ports Authority
categorisation: This gazette content involves the declaration of services as essential public services under the Essential Public Services Act, No. 61 of 1979. It constitutes a legal/regulatory action by the President, creating a regulatory framework for specific services (in this case, those of the Sri Lanka Ports Authority). While it mentions the President by name, it does not involve government personnel changes or structural reorganization, nor does it assign detailed portfolio responsibilities to an individual. The core content is a legal declaration under existing legislation, making it primarily a legal/regulatory matter.
